rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Long Beach City's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s731_lbcc_2026-11-25_s731c.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.noted_section_cut_off: The reader's note says the program's section runs onto a page the read did not hold, so part of its requirements is missing from the record.

held.why: held: the state's file lists Registered Nursing A.S. twice (02677 and 43021), and both records were read from the one Registered Nursing A.S. page under one heading; today's scorer passes it (short_high, 63 against the printed 63-64), but nothing in the committed files shows the page to be 43021's own and not 02677's: which control number the page is is the inventory's call
held: not the program's own: CSU GE-Breadth read from the LBCC-GE Plan A page, which its own note says is 'not the CSU GE-Breadth certificate named in the request'; a page search is its lever

held: d-lbcc-42970-no-units-read-or-hold-s731 stands: no_units_printed is off statewide (NG.NO_UNITS_PRINTED_ON: its matcher failed its own self-recall) and no_units_read's own check refuses it, so a record its replacement kind refuses stays held: S681's reason, 'the record does not show that the catalog prints no units; the page is read free before a gap is named'

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
records.words: Catalog text is cut off partway through the Area 4 list (last item 'CDEV C1000 Child...', units not shown); Areas 5A, 5B, 5C, 6, and the optional U.S. History/Constitution and LOTE lists are not in the text. | The page prints no total units for the pattern; total_units is null. '30 units of Cal-GETC' appears only under CSU admission requirements.

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

blocks.name: Area 2: Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
